HOW TO PLAY

  • ▲Get the boulder to the summit. You only get one: lose it and it rolls all the way down
  • ✋Hold anywhere to wind up a punch. Slide your finger to steer. Let go to punch (a quick tap is a jab)
  • ✦Let go just as the boulder rolls into you for a PERFECT. Keep holding and he blocks instead
  • 🏛Each marble gateway is a camp: pick an advantage. Reach the summit and the gods give you a gift
  • ●Grab obols (bronze 1, silver 3, gold 10). Lose the boulder with enough and Charon rows it back, once per mountain
  • ⚡Cross crevasses by bridge or ramp. Dodge the clashing rocks, and a pale glow means Zeus strikes there next
  • ↑Your score is how high you climbed, in metres

LEADERBOARD

Top 50 climbs. Your best climbs post themselves under your name.
